www.kirkland.com 

July 30, 2018 

By Hand Delivery and Electronic Filing 

Scott S. Harris, Clerk of the Court 
Supreme Court of the United States 
One First Street, N.E. 
Washington, D.C. 20543-0001 

Re: Herrera v. Wyoming, No. 17-532 

Dear Mr. Harris: 

I represent Petitioner in the above-captioned matter.  On behalf of both parties, 
I am writing to request an extension of time for the merits briefs and joint appendix 
in this case, as follows: 

Petitioner’s brief (and joint appendix):   
Respondent’s brief:   
Petitioner’s reply:    

September 4, 2018 
October 22, 2018 
November 21, 2018 

Both parties have agreed to this proposed schedule, which would allow the Court to 
hold  oral  argument  during  the  December  2018  sitting—in  particular,  during  the 
second week of that sitting.  If, before September 4, the Court should indicate that it 
intends to schedule this case for oral argument during the January 2019 sitting, the 
parties may seek a further extension of time.  Please let me know if you need any 
additional information. 

Sincerely, 

cc: 

John Knepper (Counsel for Respondent)
